body.x: Korean companies prepared a smart knowledge service pavilion and showcased their new technologiesat the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

The Daegu Digital Industry Promotion Agency (DIP, president Yang Yu-gil) set up the joint booth for the smart knowledge service at the exhibition hall of “CES 2016”. This aimed to actively promote the participating companies’ products and technologies, and support their advancement into foreign markets.

Located in Westgate Hotel, DIP’s joint pavilion was crowded with many foreign buyers who came to see the future of Korea’s smart knowledge service industry. The popularity of the exhibition was confirmed through many meetings on the products and new technologies. In particular, smart-based remote control systems and energy-saving technologies received much attention.

DIP president Yang Won-yeong said: “Six smart knowledge service companies from Daegu took part in the joint pavilion at this CES 2016. They had meetings with companies from IoT and smart sensor fields. We will continue to support projects to help small and medium-sized companies enter foreign markets, including China, Hong Kong, and Singapore.”

DIP is supporting related companies’ advancement into foreign markets, promoting the reinforcement project for quality capability of smart knowledge service, which is a promotional project for regional-specialized businesses supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy.

This project is supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Daegu city, and hosted by DIP. It is mainly focused on constructing and activating the industrial ecosystem of the smart knowledge service industry. It supports plans for new services and provides technology and marketing support to small and medium-sized companies.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
